payload.body: You tend to resist the boss, contract, deadline, or family expectation quickly, then become just as rigid when someone ignores a limit you set. Control looks unreasonable in another person's hands and necessary in your own. Underneath is often an old experience of rules being used to shame, restrict, or silence you. Ask what the rule protects before deciding whether to follow or refuse it.
payload.astroHint: Lilith opposite Saturn can make authority feel like a standoff before the rule has been judged on its actual merits.
